scope: Pre-4.17.9 multi-Hub convergence audit findings discovered before successor product changes

defects.title: Valid registry with invalid active-selection metadata has no target-driven recovery path
defects.preconditions: instances.json is structurally valid, but active_instance metadata is missing, malformed or names no registered row; at least one healthy registered target exists.
defects.bad_behavior: Early resolution fails before dispatch; ListInstances also attempts to read active selection; SwitchInstance subsequently reads previous active selection before validating the requested target. A healthy registered Hub therefore cannot reliably be listed/selected to repair active metadata.
defects.root_cause: Recovery and diagnostic paths are coupled to successful resolution of active-selection metadata instead of separating valid registry rows from the broken selection being repaired.

defects.title: Registry activation commits use baseline coherence instead of fresh full activation eligibility
defects.defect_class: transaction commit boundary / activation eligibility TOCTOU
defects.preconditions: A switch or registry bootstrap publishes/validates compatibility state, then the exact per-instance CURRENT changes before the authoritative active/registry write while remaining structurally coherent but no longer fully activation-eligible.
defects.bad_behavior: The final pre-commit guard calls Assert-RegisteredInstanceBaseline, which proves Hub/CURRENT identity/content coherence but does not enforce the stronger approved/activation-eligible contract. Durable selection can therefore be written after the stronger validation has become stale; inconsistency may be detected only post-commit.
defects.root_cause: The strongest activation predicate exists but is not the predicate freshly re-run at the authoritative commit boundary.

defects.title: Registry-active global Hub inputs are silently outside normal Hub discovery
defects.preconditions: Multi-Hub registry is active and a Hub APPROVED/CANDIDATE/candidate-transport input remains or later appears in the global Manager inbox through legacy/manual/compatibility ingress.
defects.bad_behavior: Registered Hub workflows scan the active instance inbox and can leave the global Hub-owned input invisible indefinitely; normal operation can proceed without surfacing that stranded input.
defects.root_cause: Ownership moved to per-instance inboxes without a steady-state detector/reconciler for Hub-owned objects that appear in the legacy global ingress after activation.

defects.title: BindInstance cannot rebind a moved registered Hub with the same immutable instance_id
defects.preconditions: A registered Hub moves from its recorded vault_path to a new path while preserving its immutable instance_id; the old path is stale/missing and the user invokes BindInstancePath for the new path.
defects.bad_behavior: Registry-mode Bind delegates to registration. Registration sees same instance_id at a different path and treats it as a conflict instead of an explicit rebind, so stale vault_path cannot be repaired through the advertised bind recovery operation.
defects.root_cause: Registration duplicate/conflict semantics and rebind recovery semantics are conflated; no transaction exists for changing only the registered path of the same identity.
